raw_record.question_text: Within the square $ABCD$ there are four identical rectangles (see diagram). The perimeter of each rectangle is $16\mathrm{~cm}$. What is the perimeter of this square?

method.method_draft: Describe the diagram first: the outer figure is square ABCD, and inside it four congruent gray rectangles are placed around a small central white square; two rectangles are horizontal and two are rotated vertical. Let the horizontal rectangle have dimensions a by b. From the image, the left side of the square is split into the short side b of the top-left rectangle and the long side a of the bottom-left rotated rectangle, so the square side length is a+b. From the text, each rectangle has perimeter 16 cm, so 2(a+b)=16 and a+b=8. Therefore the square side is 8 cm and its perimeter is 4·8=32 cm.

推理：设每个长方形的长和宽分别为 a 和 b。观察左边界 AD，它由左上横放长方形的短边 b 和左下竖放长方形的长边 a 组成，所以正方形的边长为 a+b。已知每个长方形的周长是 16 cm，因此 2(a+b)=16，得到 a+b=8。于是正方形边长为 8 cm，正方形周长为 4×8=32 cm。
